title: Pharmacological markers of HIV prevention for oral pre-exposure prophylaxis in men who have sex with men
task: Determining pharmacokinetic markers predictive of PrEP efficacy in men who have sex with men
key_results: PBMC-based PK predictions align with clinical efficacy; rectal tissue PK does not predict MSM efficacy (HPTN 083, DISCOVER); on-demand oral PrEP supported for MSM
comments: Mechanistic modeling elegantly resolves apparent guideline discrepancy between women and MSM by reframing appropriate PK biomarkers; relies on trial-level statistical power limitations.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Rectal tissue pharmacokinetics predict PrEP efficacy in MSM
hypotheses.result: Rejected for HPTN 083 and DISCOVER trials; insufficient statistical power in other trials

hypotheses.hypothesis: PBMC-based PK markers predict oral PrEP efficacy in MSM
hypotheses.result: Supported; predictions align with clinical efficacy estimates

hypotheses.hypothesis: Adherence requirements differ between cisgender women and MSM
hypotheses.result: Reframed—differences attributable to tissue-specific PK biomarkers, not intrinsic adherence variation

title: A unified RepVGG model factory with plug-in SE attention and GeM pooling for fine-grained agricultural classification
task: Fine-grained weed classification in agricultural imagery
key_results: RepVGG-B1 + SE + GeM achieves 99.5% F1-score on CottonWeedID15, 8.8% faster inference (188.7 ms) than ResNet101 while improving accuracy by 0.4%
comments: Strong engineering contribution combining known attention and pooling techniques with systematic benchmarking, though incremental gains suggest architectural saturation on this dataset.

hypotheses.hypothesis: SE attention and GeM pooling improve fine-grained feature discrimination with minimal parameter overhead
hypotheses.result: SE provides 0.3% accuracy gain; GeM provides 0.1–0.2% gain across RepVGG backbones

title: Multi-dimensional MRI representation and privileged learning approaches to functional outcome prediction for ischemic stroke patients
task: Predicting 90-day functional outcomes for ischemic stroke patients
key_results: Autoencoder-based representation learning with privileged information achieves Test AUC 0.801, F1 0.699, MAE 1.179 on external validation (N=738)
comments: Innovative use of privileged learning to bridge train-test discrepancy; demonstrates modular flexibility but direct CNN comparison metrics missing.

model_io.model: Autoencoder + ML/AI ensemble (classification and ordinal regression)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Privileged information during training improves generalization without requiring it at inference
hypotheses.result: Comparable or superior performance to CNN baselines with greater modularity achieved

hypotheses.hypothesis: Autoencoder embeddings effectively compress high-dimensional MRI data
hypotheses.result: Systematic evaluation confirms representation learning viable for outcome prediction

title: Rethinking scale in ophthalmic artificial intelligence: from bigger models to smarter clinical reasoning
task: Clinical trustworthiness and interpretability in ophthalmic AI systems
key_results: Conceptual framework advocating shift from model scaling toward multimodal reasoning and uncertainty-aware agentic systems
comments: Position paper emphasizing practical clinical deployment over benchmark metrics; lacks quantitative validation of proposed approaches.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Integrating multimodal evidence and external knowledge improves clinical trust in ophthalmic AI
hypotheses.result: Framework proposed but not empirically validated in abstract

title: Bag of tricks: synergistic optimization of deep patch learning fuzzy systems with multi-strategy integration
task: Structural optimization of deep convolutional fuzzy systems via multi-strategy integration for classification
key_results: Feature combination (FC), drop connect (DC), and subsystem deletion (SD) enable synergistic optimization reducing exponential rule growth and numerical instability; combined approach improves classification performance on diverse datasets
comments: Practical structural optimization techniques proposed; quantitative improvements and scalability to truly high-dimensional problems (>10D) not rigorously demonstrated.

model_io.model: Deep Patch Learning Fuzzy System for Classification (DPFSCAs)

hypotheses.hypothesis: FC, DC, and SD individually and synergistically enhance DPFSCAs performance
hypotheses.result: confirmed via experiments on diverse datasets showing synergistic optimization effects

title: Performance evaluation of tunicate-enhanced NGO resource optimization in RF energy harvesting–assisted NOMA edge computing
task: Optimize RF energy harvesting NOMA edge computing delay via metaheuristic tuning
key_results: TNGO algorithm identifies optimal time switching factor, power allocation, and task allocation ratio to minimize delay outage probability in RFE-NOMA-MEC systems under Rayleigh fading with imperfect CSI
comments: Application-oriented optimization lacking theoretical convergence analysis or comparison with standard metaheuristics on this specific problem.

hypotheses.hypothesis: TNGO optimization improves system performance over non-optimized parameters
hypotheses.result: confirmed via reduction in delay outage probability

title: A data-driven geographic information system and machine learning based multi-criteria framework for strategic wind power plant siting
task: Strategic wind farm site selection via multi-criteria framework integrating FAHP, DEA, and machine learning
key_results: Random Forest regression achieves RMSE=0.2981, R²=0.8145; classification: F1=0.9207, accuracy=0.9237; identifies 1,698 km² high-priority corridors in North Shewa; North Shewa confirmed as highest-potential zone for 250 MW Debre Birhan project
comments: Comprehensive multi-stage framework with real-world validation; significant data imbalance (1.5M sampled pixels from 31M cells) may affect spatial generalization.

inputs: expert judgment via fuzzy triangular numbers
six suitability variables (wind speed, slope, elevation, transmission distance, road distance, LULC)

model_io.model: Machine learning ensemble (Random Forest, SVM, XGBoost)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Random Forest outperforms SVM and XGBoost for wind suitability prediction
hypotheses.result: confirmed: RF achieves optimal RMSE=0.2981, R²=0.8145

hypotheses.hypothesis: North Shewa is the frontier-efficient zone with highest development potential
hypotheses.result: confirmed via DEA and validated by 250 MW project pipeline inclusion

title: AI-based visual analysis of photovoltaic panels for fault detection and maintenance support
task: Automated PV anomaly classification via deep learning with transfer learning and feature extraction strategies
key_results: Deep Feature Extraction + Classifier (DFE-C) achieves 94.05% accuracy, 100% precision on physical damage, 96% on snow coverage; comparative evaluation of FTL, DFE-C, and AFS across consistent data partition
comments: Solid systematic comparison of transfer learning strategies on a single PV dataset; cross-dataset generalization and real-field robustness not addressed.

model_io.model: EfficientNet backbone with Fine-tuned Transfer Learning (FTL)
EfficientNet backbone with Deep Feature Extraction + Classifier (DFE-C)
EfficientNet backbone with Alternative Fine-tuning Setup (AFS)

hypotheses.hypothesis: DFE-C exhibits greater stability under limited and variable data conditions
hypotheses.result: confirmed: DFE-C achieves 94.05% accuracy with superior fold-based stability

title: Critical oscillation characteristics of fluidic oscillators operating with power-law fluids
task: Characterize oscillation onset in non-Newtonian fluidic oscillators via coupled rheology-geometry analysis
key_results: Critical threshold at n≈0.61 (K≈0.163) for flow behavior–consistency coupling determines Coanda effect failure; expansion angle α>20° accelerates flow degradation; two distinct locking states identified (marginal reversible, deep irreversible)
comments: Rigorous numerical bifurcation analysis; direct experimental validation of the proposed coupling criterion would strengthen claims.

model_io.model: Unsteady numerical simulation (CFD) of feedback fluidic oscillator

hypotheses.hypothesis: Strong coupling between K and n is decisive for oscillation onset
hypotheses.result: confirmed with critical threshold n≈0.61

hypotheses.hypothesis: Expansion angle α suppresses oscillation stability
hypotheses.result: confirmed: α>20° weakens wall-attachment pressure gradient and accelerates flow degradation

title: A novel quantum motivated particle swarm method with enhanced search strategy for electromagnetic optimization problems
task: Optimize electromagnetic design parameter estimation via quantum-inspired particle swarm optimization
key_results: SQPSO achieves faster convergence, higher-quality solutions, and stronger robustness against local optima compared to established metaheuristics on electromagnetic applications
comments: Benchmark and case-study results lack specific quantitative comparisons; no theoretical convergence guarantees provided.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Probability-based mutation and tournament-driven selection improve exploration-exploitation balance
hypotheses.result: confirmed via faster convergence and higher solution quality

title: Attention mechanism-enhanced virtual reality scene generation for innovation and entrepreneurship education with cognitive load balancing
task: VR scene generation for entrepreneurship education with attention mechanisms and adaptive cognitive load balancing
key_results: Scene quality scores increase 26–45%, error rates decrease 60.9%, task completion time reduces 23.7%; cognitive load maintained within target ranges for 87.3% of session duration; ablation studies show 12–18% quality degradation upon attention component removal
comments: Strong pedagogical and technical improvements on 45 scenarios with 120 participants; generalization to other domains and long-term learning retention not evaluated.

model_io.model: Multi-scale attention architecture (spatial, channel, temporal) with adaptive cognitive load assessment

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multi-scale attention improves scene generation realism and pedagogical effectiveness
hypotheses.result: confirmed: 26–45% quality improvement, 60.9% error reduction

hypotheses.hypothesis: Adaptive cognitive load balancing maintains learners in optimal challenge zones
hypotheses.result: confirmed: 87.3% session time within target cognitive load ranges

title: Geometry of the cumulant series in diffusion MRI
task: Establish hardware-independent diffusion MRI fingerprint using cumulant tensor invariants
key_results: SO(3)-symmetric invariants identified for cumulant tensors; including all kurtosis invariants improves MS classification accuracy in 1189-subject cohort; fast icosahedral acquisition protocol achieves full brain mapping in 1–2 minutes
comments: The mathematical rigor in identifying irreducible invariants is strong, though clinical translation depends on demonstrating robustness across scanner hardware and pathology types beyond MS.

model_io.model: Rotational SO(3)-symmetric diffusion MRI signal analysis

hypotheses.hypothesis: SO(3) symmetry defines irreducible components and invariants of cumulant tensors
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; full set of hardware-independent invariants established

hypotheses.hypothesis: Including all kurtosis invariants improves pathology classification
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; enhanced MS classification in large cohort (n=1189)

title: Decoupling capacitive sensing from circuit knowledge via time-domain representation
task: Develop circuit-independent capacitive sensor readout framework using time-domain analysis
key_results: Time-domain representation eliminates need for absolute capacitance extraction; two-point anchoring corrects for circuit variations; framework validated across three distinct sensor types (liquid-level, humidity, displacement)
comments: While the paradigm shift from capacitance-centric to time-domain readout is elegant and practically useful, the approach's performance under extreme circuit variations or high-frequency interference is not thoroughly discussed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Sensor charging dynamics directly map to physical quantities without circuit-specific parameters
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; consistent responses recovered across hardware-diverse sensors

hypotheses.hypothesis: Circuit variations manifest primarily as time-axis scaling
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; simple two-point anchoring efficiently corrects scaling effects

title: Modelling the impact of climate on cholera: a case study of Kolkata
task: Project cholera transmission under climate change scenarios
key_results: Best model predicts 81–150% increase in cholera cases by 2080–2099; earlier seasonal peaks due to elevated transmission rates; contact rate and water dynamics parameters drive greatest uncertainty
comments: Mechanistic approach is valuable, but projections remain limited by gaps in epidemiological parameters and temperature-dependent bacterial growth knowledge.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Temperature and rainfall together capture seasonal cholera dynamics better than either alone
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; combined-input model outperformed univariate alternatives

hypotheses.hypothesis: Climate change will shift cholera seasonality earlier in the year
hypotheses.result: Supported; projections show earlier peaks linked to heightened early-year transmission
